_comment: The subscription (membership dues) checkout probe's fixture.
The demo org every other checkout probe uses. It is isTestAccount, so member
billing runs on Stripe TEST keys, and the probe re-proves that from the API
itself (payments/config, checkout-config and the create's own mode) before it
pays anything. `planId` must be listed on the org's public page, so a plan id
that drifted to another org is refused before any write.
`unitAmountCents` is asserted against checkout-config: a plan re-priced on
the demo org fails here rather than silently charging a different test amount.
